question: Which inorganic compound is used to manufacture soap, rayon, paper, explosives, dyes, and petroleum products?
solution:
The correct answer is __**NaOH.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Sodium hydroxide** is used to manufacture soaps, rayon, paper, explosives, dyestuffs, and petroleum products. 
 
• It is also used in processing cotton fabric, laundering and bleaching, metal cleaning and processing, oxide coating, electroplating, and electrolytic extracting.
